title: Palace: Sara Duterte has no right to demand Marcos’ resignation

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday rejected Vice President Sara Duterte’s call for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to resign, as she faces an impeachment trial that could remove her from office and disqualify her from seeking the presidency in 2028. “If she does not want to resign, that is her decision. But her call for the president to resign is utter nonsense,” Palace press officer Claire Castro said in Filipino. “She has no right to demand the president’s resignation,” she added.
